A '''Frequency Code Sequencer''' was a component used in [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] such as the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[C1 personal comlink/Legends|C1 personal comlink]]. The component was located on the base of the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="EGWT" />
